body:
Source: documentation hygiene audit of 2026-09-20 (executed plans and design notes left in docs/ after the work shipped). Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea: the eleven files below exist (6,660 lines, 345,285 bytes), describe work that has shipped, and are referenced by nothing in the tree except (a) each other and (b) the body text of two COMPLETED tickets: T38 cites files 1 and 3, T6 cites file 4. `git grep -n -I -F <basename>` over the whole repository returns no other hit. No ticket in the store carries a `spec` field, and nothing in packages/tickets or packages/rails-guard validates a path cited in a ticket body, so the two dangling citations are inert.

FILES TO DELETE (what superseded each):
1. docs/marketing/2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-plan.md (2,236 lines) - the site is live in apps/docs.
2. docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-adlc-docs-site-fumadocs.md (1,143) - apps/docs exists.
3. docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-adlc-antigravity-integration.md (1,020) - plugins/adlc-gemini and docs/integrations/gemini.md.
4. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-27-external-ticketing-sync-design.md (613) - packages/ticket-sync and docs/ticket-sync.md.
5. docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-01-adversarial-review-coverage-map.md (302) - shipped in 082e51aa as docs/adr/0008-adversarial-review-coverage-map.md, which stays.
6. docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-02-review-remediation-plan.md (250) - none of its ticket ids exist in the store.
7. docs/tokenomics-review.md (212) - analysis dated 2026-07-22 of a 29-package tree; no file links or reads it.
8. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-01-adlc-docs-site-fumadocs-design.md (208) - apps/docs exists.
9. docs/reviews/group2-completion-verification-2026-08-24.md (195) - point-in-time verification record.
10. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-01-adlc-antigravity-integration-design.md (268) - its only inbound reference is file 3.
11. docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-01-adversarial-review-coverage-map-design.md (213) - its only inbound references are file 5 and its own line 200.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. This is a deletion-only change: `git rm` the eleven paths, nothing else. After it, every touched directory still holds a file (docs/marketing: the site design; docs/superpowers/plans: 2026-07-13-sharded-ticket-store.md, which scripts/test/ticket-store-docs.test.mjs line 11 requires; docs/superpowers/specs: 2026-07-28-cross-model-truncation-anchor-design.md; docs/reviews: delta.md). scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs excludes docs/superpowers/, docs/marketing/ and docs/reviews/ from its scan by path prefix (lines 660-676) and checks nothing about what those directories contain; its requiredDocs list (lines 298-309) names none of the deleted files. docs/tokenomics-review.md is inside that scan today and simply leaves it. docs/README.md indexes none of the eleven. apps/docs, every package.json, every workflow path filter and .adlc/manifest* reference none of them. The links to `0008-adversarial-review-coverage-map.md` in docs/toolkit.md, docs/adr/0007-multimodel-adversarial-review.md, docs/adr/0010-sharded-ticket-store.md and apps/docs/content/docs/reference/adrs.mdx point at the ADR, not at file 5, and stay valid. The herdr mirror sync (scripts/sync-herdr-mirror.mjs) publishes only plugins/adlc-herdr/** and LICENSE and is not triggered by this change. The paths are not trust-root tier: packages/prosecute/lib/tier.mjs lists no docs path except docs/ci/rails-guard.yml, and the docs/marketing/** and docs/superpowers/** rails belong to T38, which is completed, so they have expired. No test, script, package or registry entry appears or disappears, so scripts/run-tests.mjs SEGMENTS and the completeness tests are untouched.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Delete exactly the eleven files above with `git rm`, so the index and the working tree change together (AC1 reads the index). Do not move anything to docs/archive/: a move removes no lines and re-adds every line of the moved file to the added-line gates.
2. Leave these in place, untouched: docs/herdr-integration-plan.md, docs/opencode-integration-plan.md, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-cross-model-truncation-anchor-design.md, docs/marketing/2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-design.md, docs/intent/backlog-grooming.md, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-13-sharded-ticket-store.md, docs/reviews/delta.md, docs/archive/**. Each of the first five has a live inbound reference (a published plugin README link, an accepted ADR plus a docs/integrations link that the smoke script resolves on disk, comments in packages/prosecute, the source-of-truth line of .adlc/specs/enterprise-contact-capture.md, and the consumed-intent line of .adlc/specs/backlog-grooming.md, whose content hash is bound by recorded spec approvals).
3. Do not edit scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs. Nothing in it goes stale, and removing a line from it would send the mutation gate to its per-file path, where a change with no added lines is refused with exit 1.
4. Do not edit any existing ticket shard. The T38 and T6 bodies keep their citations; the ticket-store guard rejects a contract change to an existing ticket in a pull request.
5. Do not edit docs/README.md, CHANGELOG.md, any test, or the comment in plugins/adlc-claude-code/lib/test/plugin-footprint.test.mjs that mentions the tokenomics analysis in prose (that test hardcodes its numbers and reads no document).
6. No new test file. The acceptance criteria below are git and grep commands with exact expected output, plus the existing guard suites.
7. One commit: `docs: delete eleven executed plans and design notes that nothing references`, with the eleven paths and the line total in the body.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA. AC7 to AC10 diff the working tree against the TIP of the base ref, so run them on a branch rebased onto the current refs/remotes/origin/main, with the tree clean.
- AC1 None of the eleven files is tracked. verify: `git ls-files -- docs/marketing/2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-plan.md 'docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-0[12]-*.md' docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-27-external-ticketing-sync-design.md 'docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-01-*.md' docs/tokenomics-review.md docs/reviews/group2-completion-verification-2026-08-24.md | wc -l` prints `0` (it prints `11` on main @ b2b5c6ea).
- AC2 The change outside .adlc/ is exactly eleven deletions. verify: `git diff --name-status refs/remotes/origin/main...HEAD -- . ':(exclude).adlc' | grep -c '^D'` prints `11` and `git diff --name-status refs/remotes/origin/main...HEAD -- . ':(exclude).adlc' | grep -vc '^D'` prints `0`.
- AC3 Nothing outside the ticket store and the manifest cites a deleted file. verify: `git grep -n -I -F -e 2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-plan -e 2026-07-01-adlc-docs-site-fumadocs -e 2026-07-01-adlc-antigravity-integration -e 2026-06-27-external-ticketing-sync-design -e 2026-07-01-adversarial-review-coverage-map -e 2026-07-02-review-remediation-plan -e tokenomics-review -e group2-completion-verification -- . ':(exclude).adlc/tickets' ':(exclude).adlc/manifest.d' ':(exclude).adlc/manifest.jsonl'` prints nothing and exits 1 (on main it prints 5 lines, all inside the delete set).
- AC4 The seven surviving neighbours are present and unchanged. verify: `git ls-files -- docs/herdr-integration-plan.md docs/opencode-integration-plan.md docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-cross-model-truncation-anchor-design.md docs/marketing/2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-design.md docs/intent/backlog-grooming.md docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-13-sharded-ticket-store.md docs/reviews/delta.md | wc -l` prints `7`, and `git diff --quiet refs/remotes/origin/main...HEAD -- docs/herdr-integration-plan.md docs/opencode-integration-plan.md docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-28-cross-model-truncation-anchor-design.md docs/marketing/2026-07-05-adlc-marketing-site-design.md docs/intent/backlog-grooming.md docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-13-sharded-ticket-store.md docs/reviews/delta.md docs/archive scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs` exits 0.
- AC5 The plugin smoke check still passes on the tree. verify: `node scripts/claude-code-plugin-smoke.mjs` exits 0 and its JSON output has `"ok": true`.
- AC6 The suites that read or walk the docs tree are green. verify: `node --test scripts/test/claude-code-plugin-smoke.test.mjs scripts/test/ticket-store-docs.test.mjs scripts/test/sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs scripts/test/ceremony-command-safety.test.mjs scripts/test/source-hygiene.test.mjs packages/spec-lint/test/readme-exit-codes.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC7 The comment gate is clean. verify: `node scripts/check-reviewer-directed-comments.mjs origin/main` exits 0.
- AC8 The rail freeze is clean. verify: `node scripts/rails-guard-ci.mjs origin/main` exits 0.
- AC9 The change is not trust-root tier. verify: `node packages/prosecute/bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs tier-check --base origin/main` prints a single line starting `tier-check: NOT trust-root tier` and exits 0.
- AC10 The mutation gate reports that it has nothing to cover rather than failing. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` prints `mutation-gate: no source files changed — nothing to mutate.` and exits 0 (park an untracked manifest segment outside the worktree first and restore it after; the gate refuses a dirty tree).

OUT OF SCOPE: moving anything into docs/archive/; the five surviving documents named in NORMATIVE 2, including their stale status lines; the stale wording in docs/integrations/opencode.md line 8; the reason strings in the smoke script's exclusion list; the root plan.json and scripts/generate-tool-docs.mjs; docs/tools/**; docs/specs/**; .adlc/specs/**; completed tickets and manifest segments.
title: docs: delete eleven executed plans and design notes that nothing references
